Friends,
In less than two weeks, I'll take the stage to debate Roger Marshall. When we meet, it won't just be the two of us up there -- I'll be speaking for every single Kansan who feels betrayed by Sen. Marshall rubber-stamping the very policies that have led to cuts in healthcare assistance, skyrocketing gas prices and out-of-control grocery costs.
**This is one of our last chances before the election to demand answers and accountability from Sen. Marshall. That 's why, before I take the stage on Oct. 21, I want to hear from you about the issues that matter most and what you'd like to see us talk about.**
[Take My Pre-Debate Survey](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/220e0e9c-316b-4da2-acfc-00b87514781d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I got into this race because Roger Marshall isn't listening to Kansans. He hasn't held a public town hall in over 580 days. He spends more time in Florida than he does listening to Kansans -- and he spends taxpayer money to do so. And he puts his party's policies, no matter how disastrous they are, ahead of the folks he was elected to represent.
That's no way to lead, friends.
Kansans deserve better than a leader who voted multiple times to stay in the Iran war. They deserve more than someone who is willing to let rural hospitals close, turns his back on our farmers and ranchers and lies about prices going down.
If Roger Marshall bothered to listen to Kansans, maybe he'd understand that -- but he doesn't.
**I do.**
That's why I've spent the last few months crisscrossing our state and talking to thousands of Kansans about the issues that are making their lives harder. I've thought critically about how to solve those problems. We need real solutions to make gas and groceries affordable again, protect Social Security for our seniors, make sure Kansans can afford healthcare and so much more.
Friends, Roger Marshall has a lot to answer for. He seems to have forgotten that leaders _should listen to the people they serve_ -- emphasis on should. You can't represent people if they never see you. You can't fight for them if you don't understand their priorities.
I've spent a lifetime listening to Kansans. When I'm elected, I'll keep listening to them. I'll be a voice for each and every one of us in the Senate. I'll put the people I represent ahead of party and politics and stand up to the chaos and corruption that dominates so much of Washington today.
**[I've already started that work by listening to Kansans from all walks of life and in every corner of the state. But today, I want to hear from you. Will you take just two minutes to complete my pre-debate survey? I need to hear from as many people as possible before I take on Roger Marshall.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/220e0e9c-316b-4da2-acfc-00b87514781d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[Take the Survey](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/220e0e9c-316b-4da2-acfc-00b87514781d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Friends, _this_ is how we defeat Sen. Marshall -- by sharing, by speaking up and by listening to each other. This is how we make sure that Kansans and the country finally get the leadership they deserve.
Thank you in advance. I can't wait to hear from you.
Adam

They’ve gathered voter data from states across the country – including swing states Arizona, Michigan, and Georgia.
They potentially entered states’ voter rolls into Palantir’s ELITE system – a tool used by ICE to identify and locate people targeted for immigration enforcement.
And the Department of Homeland Security has _refused to rule out_ sending ICE agents to our polling places on Election Day to intimidate poll workers and voters.
_Make no mistake: this is part of a broader push to expand federal involvement in elections that are supposed to be run by states and local officials._
In battleground states like Arizona, Michigan, Georgia, and Nevada, our Democratic Secretaries of State are fighting back against this invasion of privacy by the federal government. If we lose these races, there’s nothing stopping Trump and his authoritarian power grab.

subject: He told the truth. It cost him his career.
body:
What he swore an oath to do.What he swore an oath to do.
| | | | Fellow Patriot,Former Deputy U.S. Marshal Cory Novick took an oath to tell the truth. He did – and it cost him his career.**[Now I’m asking for your help to restore this decorated officer’s good name.](https://links.stayinformednow.net/u/click?_t=c02d37b0057e4505a2324dee8ee3dc76&_m=cdb4b6f4e3114557aec87a3d14994d0f&_e=qz0AGjxUAy_h8RNswT1r617XCxE1cR9JohMevRdHgK5Z51wQoNfR8tQzEAFre1BwHXwzpXm-veqgei5OlxS_0lGGMDMAsB4SgRT7tj0HUZC2HY70EW3hIv0sXX2WbRkJI2TtgCiMRJCHUtSWGK1XF9TMvL6lluHwiqlFqm6hzNRBGpeQLkXIz5f6uavn_xbbukT58ehUH93QLGYbQ30MXPHjd_gmxKxl6PK6A4Ne35de-NEmqkO6zzcUvWr4KmjinA_LkhfKlFPa1ae6EVlHF1ceKoyvn72-gqFkqJmgFrjKM116lBhmAiBk1yId5OtLgS8wI6hceK1r0GM-KBjmgRbRXu4NixpUf0zX1QIhWRjuU6mC-SGMpYU6EKDLYfCQftFGGzv3yZ56lWTkbPyxmPK2NqAe9V4ZAnz9-UUN2JilYkL2b97hcaw6sa1EUyUX5R1VREQZl6Sfr-HAIB6zrq4ag_-3R18wPhq7XyALb4Dhm4UA5TxJ_8MaPpcuVc-_jNlQDPUWJQZqvKmXfSs8MtZqdFycSvbtpKtsixe6iThILsXfBhZDNlQgXkqnO0WZSyhZ6fHuaN3wLvVcxPbbN2gnm1lIXjaolPKdu1IzhdY%3D)** In 2022, Cory was called as a government witness to testify in the politically motivated case against Washington, DC Police Officer Terence Sutton.As a former DC police officer and Calvert County Deputy Sheriff, the prosecution expected Cory’s testimony to advance its narrative that Sutton’s conduct was reckless and indifferent.But when Cory took the stand, he did what he was trained to do.
---
| | _What he swore an oath to do._**He told the truth.** The truth did not support the prosecution’s narrative. Officer Sutton was ultimately convicted. But the government was furious with Cory...
---
| |
---
| | | ...and what happened next should alarm every law enforcement officer who may one day be called to testify.**W****ithout any disciplinary action or a single incident on his record, Biden’s**** _U.S. Attorney’s Office for the District of Columbia_****abruptly added Cory to the “Lewis List.”** The Lewis List is a secretive designation of law enforcement officers whose credibility the government believes is impaired. A blacklist per se.

clean_body: What he swore an oath to do.What he swore an oath to do. | | | | Fellow Patriot,Former Deputy U.S. Marshal Cory Novick took an oath to tell the truth. He did – and it cost him his career. In 2022, Cory was called as a government witness to testify in the politically motivated case against Washington, DC Police Officer Terence Sutton.As a former DC police officer and Calvert County Deputy Sheriff, the prosecution expected Cory’s testimony to advance its narrative that Sutton’s conduct was reckless and indifferent.But when Cory took the stand, he did what he was trained to do. | | What he swore an oath to do.He told the truth. The truth did not support the prosecution’s narrative. Officer Sutton was ultimately convicted. But the government was furious with Cory... | | | | | ...and what happened next should alarm every law enforcement officer who may one day be called to testify.Without any disciplinary action or a single incident on his record, Biden’s U.S. Attorney’s Office for the District of Columbiaabruptly added Cory to the “Lewis List.” The Lewis List is a secretive designation of law enforcement officers whose credibility the government believes is impaired. A blacklist per se. | | | Placement on the list ended Cory’s service with the Marshals instantly.He was never given notice. Never given a hearing. Never even told the factual basis for the action. But now, with the support of the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF), Cory is fighting back. For over 30 years, LELDF has helped wrongly accused officers clear their names and get their lives back. We’ve supported scores of men and women through trials, appeals, administrative proceedings, and even presidential pardons.But I can’t think of a time when we’ve been called in to help an officer who was blacklisted by the government for telling the truth. Think about the message that sends to every police officer, deputy, or federal agent who may one day be called to the stand. Tell the truth — but only if it’s the truth the government wants to hear?That cannot be how our justice system works – so LELDF has made sure Cory has an experienced legal team fighting to restore his career and clear his name. But with several major trials on the horizon for other officers we support, I need to make sure LELDF has the resources to keep fighting for Cory without turning our backs on the other officers counting on us. What Biden’s DOJ did to Cory was retaliation. Plain and simple. That is not justice. That is politics. And it sends a chilling message to every law enforcement officer who might be called to the stand... and every American they may testify against.Thank you in advance for standing with Deputy Marshal Cory Novick and the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund. | | | Sincerely, Jason C. It’s grounded in a clear-eyed recognition that tough things happen and the world is deeply imperfect. But we have agency. We make choices about what we stand for and what we believe in. So I’m asking you today to use that hope to make a difference. Get involved and help Democrats win one of the most consequential elections in our country’s history. club member carried a loaded semi-automatic handgun past a Secret
Service screening checkpoint at the Trump National Golf Club in
Sterling, VA, while President Donald Trump was present at the club.

The records include an agent’s summary of the incident that states
the member took it upon himself to alert authorities on site that he

U.S. FAILS TO VET 40% OF AFGHANS ADMITTED UNDER BIDEN

The murder of a National Guardsman in Washington, DC, in November 2025
was committed by an Afghan gunman allowed into our country without
proper vetting by the Biden administration. Our _Corruption
Chronicles_ blog has the details
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85903&L=38842&F=T&].&H=5a5a755961fbbaeffd9d8e2ba000c0a122f28676e394f2c997e71dc22176a544

> Less than a year after a terrorist who entered the U.S. under a
> Biden administration program to help “vulnerable Afghans” shot
> two National Guard soldiers in Washington DC, a federal
> investigation reveals the government failed to properly screen an

On the day of the shooting, November 26, 2025, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) [ [ the “terrorist is one of thousands of unvetted Afghan nationals let into the country under the Biden Administration’s Operation Allies Welcome program.” Many on the left, including the establishment media, downplayed the information, insisting that the initiative helped susceptible Afghans, especially those targeted by the Taliban for having worked with allied forces. Under OAW around 97,000 refugees were evacuated from Afghanistan and granted a two-year parole that allowed them to apply for asylum. The DC shooter was among them. “The Biden Administration let this terrorist into the country as part of their Operation Allies Welcome program on September 8, 2021,” according to the DHS statement issued immediately after the attack. “This program let in thousands of unvetted Afghan nationals including terrorists into our country.” Lakanwal has been charged with first-degree murder while armed, assault with intent to kill while armed, and two counts of possession of a firearm during a crime of violence, in violation of the DC code. It is unlikely that Lakanwal is the only terrorist welcomed into the country under Biden’s program, according to information disclosed in a distressing new report [ issued by the DHS Inspector General (IG). Big chunks of the document are redacted, presumably for national security reasons, but the message is clear; the government failed miserably to scrutinize unknown numbers of Afghans before admitting them into the U.S., creating a huge national security risk as the Lakanwal case proves. Investigators found a 40% failure rate in the vetting of asylum claims for Afghan nationals received under OAW, including candidates with known ties to terrorism. The DHS agency in charge of performing the vetting, U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS), oversees lawful immigration and asylum officers (AO) were supposed to use special tools such as FBI fingerprint checks, biometric matching and a case management system known as Global to screen Afghans. Incredibly, they missed a lot of red flags and although pertinent information is redacted in the report, enough is available to illustrate the serious failures. “The prevalence and type of errors suggest U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services may have missed opportunities to potentially link names provided by applicants to derogatory information,” the DHS watchdog writes, adding that the lapse compromises the integrity of the alien registration file contents for future immigration administration and enforcement activities. During a random audit, investigators examined a sample of 678 applicants from a batch of 13,682 adjudicated Afghan evacuees who resettled in the U.S. The DHS IG identified 303 missed aliases, 23 missing security checks, 45 unresolved records and 115 other documentation issues. The missing security checks mean USCIS failed to run names against FBI and national security databases. The unresolved records show a failure to resolve potential matches to derogatory information such as national security concerns, criminal convictions and other misconduct that could impede asylum. “Most errors resulted from missed aliases or incomplete documentation, including two cases related to potential inadmissibility on terrorism-related grounds,” the report states. Some files had multiple missed aliases. Other errors involved an asylum officer failing to identify a spelling variation of a name or not reprinting and adding a document to a file. CLINICS RAKED IN MILLIONS AS GOVERNMENT PUSHED 'SEX-REJECTING' PROCEDURES We’re now learning the magnitude of the Biden administration’s promotion of gender “care” for children. Our Corruption Chronicles_ blog has the astonishing details [ The federal government’s ardent promotion of “sex-rejecting” medical procedures for minors during the Biden administration inspired hundreds of hospitals and health care systems, many of them publicly funded, to establish pediatric gender programs that made tens of millions of dollars using illegal billing practices to get the questionable treatments approved. More than 225 health care centers established “pediatric gender programs,” billing nearly $120 million since 2019, according to an investigation conducted by the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS). In a lengthy [ [ made public recently the agency documents its findings and they are downright outrageous. “This report exposes, for the first time, the involvement of hospitals in promoting life-altering drugs and surgeries for children who express discomfort with their sex,” HHS writes. “The stories of young boys and girls who sought to course-correct from the medical journeys designed to stunt and maim their natural bodies and functions all tell the same tale: there was no course-correction available.” Over 5,500 surgical procedures and 8,500 courses of hormones or blockers were administered to kids, with individual flagship programs reporting multimillion-dollar billings. Certain large children’s hospitals have seen gender-clinic revenue streams balloon in recent years, the HHS probe confirms. Mount Sinai Medical Center in New York and Boston Children’s Hospital are among the top grossing providers, with over $8.2 million and $6.5 million respectively in total billed charges for transgender-related services to minors between 2019 and 2023. That amounts to more than $1 million a year during each of those five years, a rarity in pediatric medicine. “In an era of razor-thin pediatric margins and pressure on hospital reimbursements, this new patient cohort—young, insured or Medicaid-eligible, and requiring perpetual follow-ups—represented a strategic area of growth,” the HHS report states. “Endocrinology and surgery departments gained volume and prestige, while hospital administrators gained a reliable revenue line that helps subsidize lower-margin services.” Around $50 million was billed for puberty blockers that were illegally coded using a fake endocrine disorder diagnostic, the probe found. Nearly $11 million in claims were filed for patients 13 to 17 using a precocious puberty diagnosis that is highly uncommon. “Healthcare providers were able to turn a tidy profit from these procedures: children who transitioned were placed on a course that would require expensive drugs, surgeries, and lifelong medical interventions,” the HHS report reads. The document cites a multitude of examples of clinics in multiple states situated within major academic medical centers, large private hospital systems, and community-based centers. The institutions and providers participate in federal programs including Medicaid and Medicare that treat children, adolescents and adults and they profit immensely from providing the services for what the left calls “gender dysphoria.” HHS determined that many providers of sex-rejecting procedures systemically diagnose minors with physical conditions they do not have to secure insurance coverage for controversial regimens like “breast removal or hormonal treatment” that might not otherwise be covered by private insurance or taxpayer-funded programs like Medicaid. The pediatric gender clinics are revenue boosters, which helps explain their rapid proliferation and resistance to concerning evidence showing poor safety and efficacy of the procedures. Kids were not the only victims of this lucrative gender medicine push. The report also reveals that the Biden administration promoted and expanded access to gender affirming procedures through executive orders, HHS civil rights guidance, Centers for Medicare & Medicaid (CMS) mandates and federal employee health benefits, pressuring hospitals and insurers to cover them for adults as well as minors. The former president issued an executive order directing government agencies to provide federal employees with healthcare coverage for comprehensive gender affirming care. The Office of Personnel Management (OPM) ordered carriers of federal employee health benefits programs to cover gender affirming care such as hormone therapy, genital, and breast surgeries as well as facial “gender affirming surgeries.” Even the Department of Defense (DOD) provided taxpayer-funded coverage of sex-rejecting procedures, and the National Institutes of Health (NIH) spent millions of taxpayer dollars on research related to sex-rejecting procedures such as puberty blockers and cross-sex hormones for youth. | | Today, I visited the Macadam ICE facility alongside my fellow members of Congress to conduct oversight and get answers about what is happening inside. We’ve heard very concerning reports that attorneys are being turned away and prevented from meeting with their clients. Meanwhile, the number of detentions is rapidly escalating, and people are being disappeared; moved past the processing facility in Portland, directly to the NW Detention Facility or other facilities outside of the state very quickly. **This facility should be a place where people detained in Oregon receive due process, not one where their rights are denied.** Every person in this country has a constitutional right to due process and the right to an attorney. These are fundamental protections for everyone, regardless of immigration status. As a physician and a member of Congress, I believe our government has a responsibility to treat people with dignity and respect their basic rights. We cannot look away when those rights are being denied. **Oversight means demanding answers, confronting abuses, and making sure the government is held accountable.** I will keep pressing for answers about what is happening with arrests being made by masked, unidentified agents in our community, how due process is being denied inside the Macadam facility, and I will keep showing up to hold our government accountable. clean_body: | | | = | | Today, I visited the Macadam ICE facility alongside my fellow members of Congress to conduct oversight and get answers about what is happening inside. We’ve heard very concerning reports that attorneys are being turned away and prevented from meeting with their clients. Meanwhile, the number of detentions is rapidly escalating, and people are being disappeared; moved past the processing facility in Portland, directly to the NW Detention Facility or other facilities outside of the state very quickly. This facility should be a place where people detained in Oregon receive due process, not one where their rights are denied. Every person in this country has a constitutional right to due process and the right to an attorney. These are fundamental protections for everyone, regardless of immigration status. As a physician and a member of Congress, I believe our government has a responsibility to treat people with dignity and respect their basic rights. We cannot look away when those rights are being denied. Oversight means demanding answers, confronting abuses, and making sure the government is held accountable. I will keep pressing for answers about what is happening with arrests being made by masked, unidentified agents in our community, how due process is being denied inside the Macadam facility, and I will keep showing up to hold our government accountable. | | | | | | Everyone deserves to have their rights respected. No exceptions. Keep the pressure on, Dr. Maxine Dexter | | | | | = | | Maxine Dexter is a critical care physician with decades of experience using facts and following science to help her patients. name: Kylie Glatfelter
subject: ICYMI: Back to Basics: Tackling America’s $40 Trillion Debt
body:
No images? [Click here](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-e-fdjklut-hhlljjcji-x/)
# [ICYMI](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fdjklut-hhlljjcji-r/): Nieshalla Calls for a "Back to Basics" Approach to Tackling the $40 Trillion National Debt
By Indiana State Comptroller Elise NieshallaThere is a reality we must acknowledge to begin moving toward national fiscal solvency and sanity -- resources are finite. Accepting this fundamental fact is our Vince Lombardi moment to zero-in on the basics, just as his Green Bay Packers team did after he delivered his famous line, "Gentlemen, this is a football." They then went on to win the NFL Championship that year.Getting back-to-basics with our country's finances means we first must deal with our unsustainable practice of [borrowing](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fdjklut-hhlljjcji-y/) $2 trillion each year to fill in the gap between spending $7 trillion while only bringing in $5 trillion. Adding $2 trillion to our debt annually over the last decade has quickly doubled our liability from $20 trillion in 2017 to [$40 trillion](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fdjklut-hhlljjcji-j/) now.Yet while we are still enjoying growing capital markets, the concerns over our growing national debt are increasingly difficult to ignore as our country [spends](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fdjklut-hhlljjcji-t/) over $1 trillion each year on debt interest (roughly equivalent in size to our U.S. Military and Medicare budgets). Furthermore, U.S. Treasury bonds now carry debt risk that has pushed up interest rates, and our debt is greater than our gross domestic product.Hitting the $40 trillion mark is another red-light warning that demands we focus on fundamentals to overcome this huge economic and national security threat that has been decades in the making under both Republican and Democratic leadership.For starters, there is a back-to-basics gameplay gaining bipartisan momentum in Congress that would signal to the states and world that America is tackling its spending problem. And the play? -- to [reduce](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fdjklut-hhlljjcji-i/) the deficit-to-GDP ratio from 6% to 3% over the next 10 years -- and then in the following 10 years, get our country back to a balanced budget. The fact that this is gaining much-needed support is encouraging and could serve as the needed kickoff to a multifaceted, coordinated effort over multiple decades to also get our debt-to-GDP ratio down to a manageable level.This will require difficult decisions, fiscal discipline and leaders willing to look beyond the next election and fully engage in the work of restoring our country's solvency. Examples of this challenging work include:• Restructuring our major spending programs of Medicare, Medicaid, and Social Security that are going insolvent in the early to mid 2030s. They need to become viable for the most vulnerable, for the long-term -- while finding new path for the young that leverages the power of time.• Delivering a safety net designed to move Americans in tough times toward lasting independence.• Protecting every taxpayer dollar from fraud. U.S. Treasury Secretary [Scott Bessent](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fdjklut-hhlljjcji-d/) has warned that as much as ten percent of our federal budget is lost to fraud each year. Thanks to President Trump's Task Force to Eliminate Fraud, there is a serious effort to find and root it out.In Indiana, we know that major turnarounds are possible, whether in college football or government finances.While our Indiana University Hoosiers have suffered more losses than any other college football team -- 715 -- last year they won the championship, and coach Curt Cignetti stated, "There is no magic here. It is fundamentals."While the IU Hoosiers had to develop an intense focus on fundamentals to overcome the long-seated challenges, so did the State of Indiana. We were operating for years under fiscal duress and in the year 2002, our state delayed hundreds of millions of dollars in payments to school districts so our books could close "in the black" with six cents -- yes, 6¢.That was Indiana's Lombardi/Cignetti back-to-fundamentals moment. We had to make changes, and after more than 20 years of grit, determination and innovation, our state has gone from six cents to common sense and now has a healthy reserve, low debt, well-funded pensions and a AAA credit rating.Turnarounds happen when there's extraordinary focus and discipline, and that is now needed from us as Americans. We must get to work to save ourselves from a debt spiral crisis of epic proportions that will affect our families, our fortunes and our freedom.It is high time we get back to basics and come together as the team of States to support our federal government in delivering a credible play book to restore our nation's fiscal solvency, strength, stability ... and financial independence.America has overcome enormous challenges before -- getting our fiscal house in order must be one of them. [](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fdjklut-hhlljjcji-h/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fdjklut-hhlljjcji-k/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fdjklut-hhlljjcji-u/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fdjklut-hhlljjcji-o/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fdjklut-hhlljjcji-p/) | [Unsubscribe](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-u-fdjklut-hhlljjcji-m/)

clean_body: Peter, it's Wes. You may know I’m a veteran, father, and Maryland’s first Black governor. If there’s one thing I’ve learned from my time serving the people of Maryland, it’s this: You can't govern by throwing temper tantrums when you don’t get your way. That’s all I’ve seen come out of Trump’s Washington -- policies based on fear and chaos, not love and compassion. That’s not how we do things in Maryland. I’m proud to be a Governor who’s fighting to keep families fed, workers protected, and our schools fully funded -- even when Washington tries to pull the rug out from under us. But this isn’t a fight I can keep up alone, Peter. I need this team behind me to keep proving Maryland does things differently. Elevate, Wes

subject: Our fight against data centers
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Justice Democrats
body:
A nine-month loophole could leave Durham with decades of damage.
[](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20261010-na.MzB0TU&refcode=em20261010-38338&amp%3Bamounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amp%3Bamount=10&t=2&akid=38338%2E1203867%2EyBzoXD)
Hi Peter,
It’s Nida Allam, Durham County Commissioner and former Justice Democrats endorsed candidate for Congress.
When a pipe bursts in your house, the first thing you do is shut off the main water valve. You don’t leave it dripping while you assess the damage. You shut it down, figure out what went wrong, and make a plan to fix it.
Durham County was supposed to do the same thing with data centers.
Our Board of Commissioners passed a nine-month moratorium so we could study the long-term effects of these facilities, but the final policy included carve-outs allowing facilities of up to 100,000 square feet to move forward. That’s roughly the size of two football fields!
More than 60 Durham residents showed up to oppose these carve-outs. High school students, college students, farmers, and lifelong residents all asked us to take their health and their future seriously.
I fought to remove the carve-outs completely. When that motion failed to receive a second, I successfully added amendments requiring companies to disclose their expected electricity use, water consumption, and cooling fluids.
But I still voted no on the final moratorium because we should be doing more. This nine-month-long moratorium is temporary, but any data center approved through these loopholes could remain in Durham for decades. Our communities deserve better than learning the consequences after the damage is already done.
**[That is why I’m asking you to split a donation between our campaign and Justice Democrats today.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20261010-na.MzB0TU&refcode=em20261010-38338&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=3&akid=38338%2E1203867%2EyBzoXD)**
**Justice Democrats is taking on the corporate-backed Democratic establishment and working to send more unbought progressives to Congress** — bold leaders who will defend working-class communities from data centers and hold Big Tech accountable.
**[Contribute $10](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20261010-na.MzB0TU&refcode=em20261010-38338&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=22&akid=38338%2E1203867%2EyBzoXD)**
The cloud is not floating somewhere above us. It is built on our land, connected to our power grid, and drawing from our water supply.
Durham residents deserve an honest say in what gets built here and what risks we are expected to carry. Together, we can keep fighting for a future where clean water and healthy communities come before corporate convenience.
– Nida

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20261010-38338-footer&t=23&refcode2=38338_1203867_yBzoXD&akid=38338%2E1203867%2EyBzoXD)**

subject: This poll from the New York Times changes everything
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Heartland Patriots (LucasKunce
body:
The New York Times last polled our race 3 months ago and found us down 7. This poll has swung 10 points since then.
Peter, look at this:
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/109651?refcode=em20261010-10989&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=10989%2E614464%2EYRAvgC)
In June, the _New York Times/Siena_ poll had me trailing Greg Abbott by 7 points, 51% to 44%.
**Today, that same poll has me ahead, 49% to 46%.**
That's a 10-point swing in three months, from one of the most respected pollsters in the country. It's not a fluke, either. This is the third poll showing us ahead of Abbott, and it's the most recent one, taken after weeks of Abbott's attack ads flooding Texas airwaves. **[Split $25 right now between Heartland Patriots and my campaign to help us turn this polling lead into a win.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/109651?refcode=em20261010-10989&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=10989%2E614464%2EYRAvgC)**
The _New York Times_ also ran a major story on the state of play in Texas. Read this:
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/109651?refcode=em20261010-10989&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=10989%2E614464%2EYRAvgC)
**Ten-to-one. Abbott has thrown everything he has at this race, and he still can't put it away.**
Wendy Davis put it this way in the same article: "People have vastly underestimated Gina. Dollar for dollar, she's running the best statewide campaign we've ever seen."
That's what grassroots supporters like you have built $5 and $10 at a time. We haven't come close to matching Abbott's money, but every dollar has gone further than anyone thought it could. **[Will you split a contribution today between Heartland Patriots and my campaign to help us keep our momentum going in the final stretch?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/109651?refcode=em20261010-10989&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=10989%2E614464%2EYRAvgC)**
The Times was also honest about what still stands in our way. Texas has 20 separate media markets, and national donors routinely pass the state over because reaching all of them is so expensive. And one in five Texas voters still doesn't know who I am.
Here's what the last three months have taught us: the more Texans get to know me, the more this race moves. **Every one of those voters is someone we can reach, but only if we have the resources to do it.** Abbott has raised more than $106 million in this race, and he's going to keep spending it in the final month to drag this race back his way.
We are 24 days from Election Day. The polls tell us this race can be won. What happens next depends on whether we have the financial resources to communicate our message to the voters who need to hear it.
**[Can you split $25 right now between Heartland Patriots and my campaign to help us reach every voter in every corner of Texas and defeat Greg Abbott on November 3rd?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/109651?refcode=em20261010-10989&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=10989%2E614464%2EYRAvgC)**

| Bruce Blakeman I’m sounding the alarm. | | | | | [](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwMjUsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAAA3C7zUy2znVKahI7GsKW0u0pVojeeaDYVSe9Pm44gcmSndDvdvD6s4Xg6O0YFZTRpVQhtqvUeUx0DmniFTDBVzcpAoaGfFKX2xAO_wSJJA)
---
Dear Patriot, I’m sounding the alarm. Radical Kathy Hochul has officially BANNED all local police cooperation with ICE agents – and this is just a taste of the nightmare she has in store for all of us in New York if she wins re-election on November 3rd. **[I need your urgent help to DEFEAT KATHY HOCHUL. ](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwMjUsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAAA3C7zUy4vJXDz0EqWtSjppS0G0q_u3aCzuJ6I6LoAUGK1nNAYo-Yiedxyvs0rPo93qY27_MufNbFVGR-0yL2gU7wxwvUvMXEPxJBICB-1g)** With just over one month to go until Election Day, Hochul’s anti-ICE “political stunt” is costing New Yorkers their lives. In fact, according to DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin, **13,000** individuals since January 20th have been released into our communities in New York after ICE tried to put detainers on them. These are murderers, rapists, pedophiles, and drug traffickers that Kathy Hochul released from custody and sent across New York. Instead of going after the criminals and illegals who are terrorizing us... ... Hochul is going after the police. It’s wrong. And our one chance to stop her is on November 3rd. **That’s why my campaign team is urgently gearing up to launch a massive TV ad buy exposing Hochul’s lawless, pro-criminal agenda, and I need your help to make it happen.** In fact, I need to raise **$123,200** to get this ad on the air. **Will you send a $25 campaign contribution today to help me raise the money I need to launch this ad statewide? ** Remember, contributions up to $250 will be eligible for a 600% match, which means you can help me raise the funds I need for this ad 6x faster! I hate to be so direct, but time is running out, and every New York voter needs to know that Hochul puts the wants of criminals and illegals above the safety of their family. Kathy Hochul has gone so far down the path of socialism that she’s even bragging about putting _Illegals First_ and _New Yorkers Last_ ... ?
---
---
Hochul is a political snake. I’ll let her own words speak for themselves:
---
Kathy Hochul in 2024: **“Someone breaks the law, I’ll be the first one to call up ICE and say, ‘get them out of here.’”** Kathy Hochul in 2026: **“I wish [ICE] would just disband... this is a rogue policing state that is wreaking havoc.”**
---
She doesn’t believe in anything she pushes. She will simply do and say _whatever it_ _takes_ to get power... **And the terrifying reality is that right now in New York, that means supporting lawless socialism.** I know you agree that we cannot give her another four years as governor. She will utterly destroy New York. But when I defeat her, I will repeal sanctuary state mandates, support law enforcement at every level, restore order in our prison system, and give our frontline heroes the support they deserve. This is exactly what New York needs, but it’s going to be the fight of a lifetime to win this race. **Will you help me defeat radical Kathy Hochul by helping me launch a final massive TV ad buy across the state to expose her lawless, pro-criminal agenda?** **Will you help me raise the $123,200 I need to get this TV ad on the air? ** With just over one month left until Election Day, TV ads are the #1 way I can reach millions of New York voters. Of course, New York has one of the most expensive media markets in America, which is why this ad is going to cost me $123,200. [**So if you could give a larger contribution today, say $50, $100, or more, it will help me raise what I need in no time at all.** ](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwMjUsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAAA3C7zUy6uRPIw4QQ3_PhAWIYzOTd6t1ypHYWlEEI3IkOf1Oyx5PDhJ07jVIW1PYzxYDF5BIlvjvh-t9tU-ZBcJ7T4yDpARlcWbIwxKK_Pg) _Don’t forget that your contribution up to $250 will be eligible for a 6x match!_ All I ask is that you hurry. That will ensure I get this ad on the air before Election Day. Thank you for standing with me – and thank you for hurrying!
---
For New York, Bruce Blakeman
---
P.S. It’s no wonder that radical Kathy Hochul has officially banned all police cooperation with ICE. She endorsed Communist Mayor Zohran Mamdani, who has supported defunding the police and abolishing ICE for years. This is just a taste of what Kathy Hochul plans to do to New York if she’s given another four years in Albany to wreak havoc. **We’ve got no choice but to defeat her on November 3****rd****!** I need to get an urgent new TV ad on the air statewide to make sure that every voter knows Hochul puts _Criminals and Illegals First_ and _New Yorkers Last_. **Will you send your $25 or more contribution to help me raise the $123,200 I need to get this ad on the air? Thank you, and please hurry! **

name: Team Collins
subject: Susan bleeds Patriots red — and Maine runs through her veins
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Collins for Senator
body:
While Troy Jackson cheers for Pittsburgh, Susan's never left the sideline for Maine.

While Troy Jackson cheers for Pittsburgh, Susan's never left the sideline for Maine.
| We need to tell you something about Troy Jackson.He's spent years in the Maine State Senate claiming to fight for Mainers. But here's a small detail that tells you everything you need to know about where his loyalties really lie: Troy Jackson is a Pittsburgh Steelers fan.Not the Patriots. Not New England. Pittsburgh.Now, maybe that sounds trivial. But ask any Mainer -- the teams we root for say something about who we are and where we come from. Susan Collins always cheers for the Patriots. Through losing seasons and Super Bowl runs, she's never once wavered. Because that's what it means to be a Mainer: you show up, you stay loyal, and you don't abandon home just because somewhere else looks shinier.Susan has spent her entire life right here in Maine -- not just rooting for our team, but rooting for us. Fighting for our fishermen, our paper mills, our veterans, and our small towns in Washington for over three decades.Troy Jackson wants Susan's seat. But before he can tell you he's "for Maine," ask yourself: can you trust someone who roots for Pittsburgh over the Patriots to put Maine first?Susan Collins has never needed to ask that question about herself. Her commitment to this state isn't a talking point -- it's a lifetime record.[We need to make sure Susan has the resources to get her message out before Election Day. Will you chip in $25 right now to stand with a true Mainer?](https://trk.email.goprelease.)

10/24: Waukesha County Table at Halloween on the Street in Delafield****For more information, please visit:[wisgop.org/calendar/events/](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fdiyhud-didthutlhu-j/) ** **Dane County**
Dane County Republicans hosted many events over the past few weeks, including a Save Wisconsin Saturday with Chairman Brian Schimming, Pints & Politics, and an election integrity event. **Door County**
Last weekend, Door County Republicans hosted Attorney General candidate Eric Toney, State Treasurer John Leiber, State Senate candidate Nic Cravillion, and Assemblyman Joel Kitchens. Senator Ron Johnson also called in to speak to attendees. The theme was lowering taxes, protecting victims and holding criminals accountable, and protecting our values and way of life here in Wisconsin. **Green County**
In the past couple of weeks, the Republican Party of Green County participated in a number of events. They attended a fundraising event for Jon Aleckson, candidate for the 50th Assembly District, where they heard from keynote speaker Tommy Thompson. They also celebrated Cheesedays weekend in Monroe with a pie sale at the Victory Center and a visit from Tom Tiffany. **Monroe County**
Tom Tiffany joined Monroe County Republicans at Warrens Cranfest on Friday, September 24. He also walked in the La Crosse Maple Leaf parade that Saturday alongside Derrick Van Orden and many other candidates. Monroe County Republicans also participated in Sparta's Fallfest on October 3rd and had great interactions with voters. **Shawano County**
Republicans in Shawano County walked in the Caroline Calorama parade with Attorney General Candidate Eric Toney. **St. Croix County**
St. Croix County Republicans held multiple Save Wisconsin Saturdays and candidate flag waves, including one with Rep. Rob Kreibich. They also wrote hundreds of postcards during a Team Tiffany Tuesday and held a GOTV Faith Committee meeting for prayer and contacting churches. **Vilas County**
On October 3rd, a large and enthusiastic crowd came out to see Tom Tiffany in Eagle River. Topics ranged from election integrity, no tax on tips, gun safety, the budget surplus, and more. Yard signs were also distributed and can be seen throughout Vilas County. **Washburn County**
Washburn County Republicans walked in a recent parade in the area. They also held their annual Reagan Day Dinner on September 16th in Spooner. **Waukesha County**
October 2-3, Waukesha County Republicans participated in the Freedom Firearms Gun Show in Dousman. They registered new voters, signed up new members, and distributed yard signs. | Friend, Currently, there are no vacancies on the Supreme Court. But make no mistake: the knives are already out. Justice Samuel Alito is 76 years old and expected to retire within weeks. Justices Clarence Thomas and John Roberts will likely follow before Trump's second term ends. And according to the Washington Post, the auditions for Trump’s next SCOTUS picks have already started:

| Conservative judges across the country are writing increasingly unhinged opinions designed to catch Trump's eye, signaling their loyalty before a seat even opens. One opened a dissent with a crude term for male genitalia. Another reversed his long-held position on birthright citizenship almost overnight. These judges are competing for a lifetime appointment, and whoever wins will sit on that court for decades. This is the endgame. Trump replaces three older justices on the court with younger extremists, and liberals are locked out of the Supreme Court for an entire generation. This is how Trump’s America becomes permanent. The only way out of this nightmare is to expand and rebalance the court, and it does not require a constitutional amendment, just a law passed by Congress. That means Democrats must take back the House, Senate, and White House by 2028 and have the courage to act. That is what our Unpack Our Courts initiative is building. But we cannot wait until 2028 to fight. This November we are protecting state Supreme Courts in Nevada, Kentucky, Montana, Michigan, and Minnesota and backing Democrats in critical races while we build the national movement for federal reform. Every piece of this fight is connected and every race matters. Over 100,000 Democrats have already joined our fight. We are building the infrastructure to reform the court right now, while there is still time to stop this. body:
Corporations shouldn’t have the ability to influence our elections with giant checks.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20261010-6821-footer&t=1&akid=6821%2E420207%2E12GhyI)
Peter,
Corporations don’t get a vote in our elections. So why can they influence them with giant checks?
In 2010, the Supreme Court decided corporations could funnel unlimited amounts of money into politics. Their logic was restrictions on political spending infringed on corporations’ free speech rights.
**As a result, super PACs were born. Corporations gained significant influence over everything from taxes to regulations, boosting their own profits at the expense of working people.**
I introduced my We the People Amendment to overturn the Supreme Court’s decision in _Citizens United_ , clarify that corporations are _**not**_ people, and establish that money is _**not**_ free speech.
And I will continue to fight until we get Big Money out of politics once and for all. But this kind of change is only going to happen when enough people stand up and demand it.
[**Peter, if you’re with me, will you add your name to my petition to demand Congress end Citizens United and get corporate money out of politics for good?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/sign/em20261010_citizens_united_petition/?utm_source=em20261010-6821&t=2&akid=6821%2E420207%2E12GhyI)

## Military Execution to Be Live-Streamed
The Pentagon [plans to live-stream](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0MFq4zAQBuCnkW8O0ki24oMOC4tvWfbWo5lYo3iKYgVrkjRvX9xCX6DMceD_-f6303RCzrxe_uGVgqQyrfSsmURom273c-aZPmi-C5c1MlXKkTBPoKFvjW6NnnAWftDksIkhEQHZhoLxg-mh7wfXLCFG521CDzR0cYCOEqSz9-AcQOfd0HDY84zeT7vOHpKmAQ0eNSZDR4rKaYosZTu8F15loZRf5UHbYS7XJodF5FaV_aNgVDDied4N-0_B-L9kFp6rgnGhSyVZ2gUrru0Pq_1mKhirlO2l7MhR2b_GemO0t67ZQrw9OWeuvVdOX67I-atZfjnYI8BnAAAA__-MFH_h) the Dec. 3 execution of Nidal Hasan, the former Army major who killed 13 people and wounded 32 in the 2009 Fort Hood shooting. Hasan will face an Army firing squad at 1 p.m. at Fort Hood, the hour chosen to roughly match when the attack began. President Trump [approved the method](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykULFuxCAU-xqyJQIuB8nA0CXbde0YvcDj8ioSUiCX9u8r-guVB1uyZMv-eMwPoED78x02NMXHeccrBywF03ycSyCL32jPQnF3hBmDQwiz5FK1greCz2ALvXDuoXHGI0q8NWiEHoWSSo19s5pR61EvatHKqsFz710v5B2UH_QdLV8aMjVP8Are32-d5ziCgIGDFzigYz1HRyWm7jPSXlb04Se-MHU2bk0waylHZrc3Jicmp-u6OrvkuqP6TE5VViIHoV0hw956SrQ_2_x1gmtLOreDyalJxh0XhUBZadbz5wYU_jrKP695GfkbAAD__7izeh0) on the recommendation of Secretary of War Pete Hegseth. _"We'll make sure that people are able to watch it, that it's public,"_ Hegseth said. It would be the military's first execution since 1961. The idea of a public execution drew bipartisan pushback, with Vice President JD Vance [expressing doubts about the plan,](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkbGOnDAYhJ_GdF4Z4-WWgmKjiO7SnHQp0b_2sPhkbGT_wO3bR6TIC0RTjjTS983v9_GdfPDx-YsW9DylMeIoAczI47o9grf4ht3Yp-g8CoIDhVEr3cpayVqNZNnvGA1Vrp8AjaZCX791davbtjPV3NumUXSbtNEwgOquTpm6Ufpq29Z01Fa-P_dqdUaZa3OZFDqq6aZoqnGDE0bBeU758pV85BlTeKUd-WLTUoV-Zl6LaO5CD0IPx3FclhLPTugBUW5F6OHEEnpIPCMLPXw5uVO0kPheM0pBkS5tD5b0SBvL4HcUzqDFx6ecUmY5p-RkmVNiZPnPiSz0KnKGPNIWXGR5ENtZ6IGyvN-1-8Tnh2iGZL0Tzc8fp2gc5QN5rXLv1sOH4Ev7Jox6LuTDXyD-zx_2Xv8JAAD__5W1oRw) and saying if it was live-streamed, he wouldn't watch it.
## Isaias Barrels into Panhandle
Hurricane Isaias [strengthened into a major Category 3](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkMFugzAQRL_G3IjWNgFz8KFSxS29VFWPaMFL2NbYyHaS5u8r-gvVHEcazXufl_GC7Dlc33AjW5Y4BnpkT6VQGvfb5HmmH5pvhWNwTJm8I_SjAtXWEmoJI86F7zQ2WDm7ECnSFVnZ9bJVbds31WrPkzEIEhuAvgMDs-7BKem0ASlBTxXbY0_CEWjO-rQA9SjRAC6SDDnRADkuMZ2-Ioey0uKf8U7pNMet8nYtZc9Cvwg1CDXgNB8MRyfU8PEu1LDeUuIZA9WckTHXBb8p18hbvfiY2GG9Y1gxOE9CDbnE9BR6YCf0q9SdVMoYqJJ1-4O959x2ooHrhuz_HpR_irtb9RsAAP__lveBrA) storm Friday and was expected to come ashore near Pensacola between 8 and 10 p.m. last night, with 120 mph winds, storm surge up to 9 feet, and as much as 15 inches of rain. Gov. Ron DeSantis declared a state of emergency for 27 counties and mobilized about 5,000 National Guard troops. Okaloosa County ordered [mandatory evacuations](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u4yAUhJ8Gd1j8xT8FxTbusu2W1jEc4rPCEAGJb97-yvcVrqabkUbfzL_7egeKlB5_4UDbQl4TnjVia1jW52uL5PAL3atRTp6wYvQIcVVCDVwKLsUKrtEbVwOdtwFRoe7QynGWgxqG2XS7lSqYSc7btG3BY7jNBkfU2o1aO6-HsSN79UlxSZib7oPAGSRMAoLECT0zAj21XPr_mVLbMcRPfmPpXT66aPfWnpXpP0wtTC3nefZuq9eOK2dqOQgOYmq5LKaWEHMhD7w2aMhz4HhgeWByH04VCCrfX6WQg4S8ItSc-MXH1NIV658nxUh1GJkRjwMo_kC0X373tuo7AAD__08ShbA) and opened shelters. Two Miami-based search and rescue teams, 168 responders in all, [deployed to Tallahassee](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkbGunDAQRb8GOq9s47BQuEhD99KmRIN9_ZjEYGSbJfn7iFWa1NFIUxyN5urofv-YP4gj75_faIOtIc07rhJRK_J8nEtkh19wZ-W0e0ZB9KA4a6l7oaRQciZX-YXZUOttADS6FlY9R9Xrvh9Nu9plQBjHDmbxQT_VoN0CQ8HIUS2jN2jZ3v-UvEeaL90jSIykaJAUFAb4xkh4rik_fiTe64oQf6cX8sOlrY12rfUoTfe10VOjp-u6HvviNqaN74MbgeqK3OhpPXNmRztEAZW0_4O4EFMRR07bUYvAi9xJt3kRxa0pReFiKmdGESGmzJ7EO-Xv9uQhAmeIjOJOiErlpwgpOzR66oanVKNq9NRm64-LY-TSPxsjPzfi-Fap_9nAy-o_AQAA__8XEKBK) for a two-week stay. Forecasters also warn of flash flooding and tornadoes into Saturday.
## Bears Legend Mike Ditka Dies at 86
Mike Ditka, who coached the 1985 Chicago Bears to the franchise’s only Super Bowl title, [died at age 86](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGurCAYhJ8GOwwgoltQ3IZub3tL868Myl0Uo-x69u1PPK9wMuUkk_m-f_fhTjHFdfpLC2wJeVhxHgmlYB-21yPFEV8YXyXm1UccSB6UBiWU4VJwKQYaS3xj0FR5GwCFpoKV3U0aZcxNV7MdO-F9Qw-SbQi6160JikL_AGTX99pU0V57UlwRum3qIHAjSb2gINHDMy3gY8l7_T_HtcwI6ZPf2OsxL1WycynbwZo_TDmm3HmeNY5tvUqm3BoSU-4oef8w5QamXPRMuVZILTohmXIJE1ZP-4ePmcaZz5QSD7SAF_AlPsF9LE_iFz-nCbw31W79dsaU4mE6psW0UEw_b8ovJb6t-g4AAP__femGPg), his family announced Friday.

The son of a welder, Ditka earned the nickname “Iron Mike” as a football star in Pennsylvania’s steel country. As a coach, he became known for his fiery temper, and his 1985 Chicago Bears shared his larger-than-life image, captured in the team's [_Super Bowl Shuffle_ music video](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1ugzAABOCnMVuQ_wph8NAqiqpK6dClo2Xsc3BlMAKDk7ev6CtUt91J33DfN30zIYbp_mlGqOyTnlDWiJyx6HnrY7B4wG45pMkFrIgOJmpOeXNi9MSoNjaHHVqayikPcIgKirUda3jTdLIaVO_Pbeu8ZVIy6SE4Q2e599T1ApTyKqjDY_QIlS-i9hSdYeZMjWc4wxFJ4UJOS_2TwpQH-PhMO5baprGKash5Xol4JfxK-LWUUj_Tlrcex340JtuBiOtOxOVtKuPjo_m6vJdqUW4uIcawNi2R9D6aEP_I_M8ndsV_AwAA___BWXOH).

Peter,
For months, the Trump administration has tried to rig the upcoming election by using the U.S. Postal Service to block mail ballots from reaching voters.
The courts, including the Supreme Court, have repeatedly blocked the scheme.
But by every indication, Trump still plans to use the Postal Service to rig this election. And the latest proof is bonechilling.
The Trump admin is now deploying nearly 1,000 armed guards from Prosegur, a private security firm accused of human rights abuses, to postal facilities across the country ahead of the November election:
---

Why is Trump assembling an army of armed guards and federal agents around our elections this November?
Democrats must stay focused on what we have to do to save our country. We have to get out and vote, and make this election too big to rig. When we flip the House and Senate, we must immediately move to impeach and prosecute Trump for treason.
Defend Our Courts is fighting to expand the firewall of state Supreme Courts, the courts that can prevent Trump's election rigging, on a national scale, while turning out voters in states with key House and Senate races.

If you walk into my family's restaurant in Manchester on any given afternoon, you'll hear the same sounds I've heard my entire life: the clinking of coffee mugs, the hum of blenders, and the rhythm of neighbors talking in a booth. **It 's the sound of New Hampshire -- and the community that shaped me.**
My great-grandfather started his business 109 years ago. He was a Greek immigrant who didn't have much, but he believed that if you worked hard, treated people right, and gave back to your community, this country would give you a fair shot.
Long before I served in Congress, I was in the kitchen at the restaurant making homemade ice cream. In a year we'd churn out more than 35,000 gallons of it!
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e70a3290-a42c-4e2e-8501-da1429b72c57?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

Helping run my family's small business showed me the power of hard work and serving others.
But unfortunately the opportunity that my ancestors and others sought has never been further away, and Donald Trump and his administration are too busy cutting deals for their billionaire buddies to give a damn.
**I decided to run for Senate to change that.**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e70a3290-a42c-4e2e-8501-da1429b72c57?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[ DONATE](https://substack.com/redirect/e70a3290-a42c-4e2e-8501-da1429b72c57?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I've traveled across the Granite State on the campaign trail -- from the Seacoast to the North Country -- and the stories I hear are the same: People are working harder than ever and doing everything right but still seem to be falling behind.
The system isn't working. More often than not, it feels rigged for those at the top -- while the rest of us are just trying to scrape by.
**That 's why I'm running for Senate:** We deserve leaders who fight for all of us, not just the wealthy and well-connected. And it's about time that our economy works for everyone.
_I 'm also running to bring a new voice to the Senate and stand up for all Granite Staters._
Growing up in New Hampshire, I often wondered if there would be a place for me here -- if I'd be able to live openly and authentically in the state I love. I certainly never imagined I could one day be elected to public office as a member of the LGBTQ+ community.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e70a3290-a42c-4e2e-8501-da1429b72c57?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[DONATE](https://substack.com/redirect/e70a3290-a42c-4e2e-8501-da1429b72c57?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
After college I returned home to help run my family's restaurant and decided to run for the state legislature because I wanted to give back to the city and state that had given me so many opportunities.
And somewhat to my surprise, not only did my community accept me, they gave me their trust and sent me to Concord to serve them.
I'll never forget the first speech I made from the State House floor. At the time marriage equality was far from the law of the land, and the legislature was debating a bill that would have prohibited New Hampshire from recognizing same-sex marriages performed in other states.
I told my colleagues that the bill ran counter to the "Live Free or Die" spirit we're so proud of in New Hampshire and that we shouldn't be legislating based on fear or hate or trying to punish people for who they love.
Unfortunately the bill passed, and we lost that fight. _But we didn 't give up._
We persevered, and not long after the legislature passed a new bill recognizing civil unions between same-sex partners. And a few years after that, New Hampshire became the first state in the nation to legalize marriage equality through legislative action.
It was a remarkable turnaround that showed real progress is possible, and that's made an immeasurable difference in the lives of so many who call New Hampshire home -- including my husband and me.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e70a3290-a42c-4e2e-8501-da1429b72c57?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[DONATE](https://substack.com/redirect/e70a3290-a42c-4e2e-8501-da1429b72c57?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**I 'm not running to make history -- I'm running to make a difference for every Granite Stater who feels like their voice isn't being heard by those who represent them.**
During this campaign the contrast between me and my opponent, John Sununu, has only grown stronger.
I've spent my time in Congress taking on tough fights. I'm ranked one of the most bipartisan members of the House because I'll always look for a chance to deliver results. But I'll also take on anyone to do what's best for New Hampshire -- regardless of political party.
_We 're seeing a different approach from Sununu and the Republican side._
The GOP sows extreme rhetoric and threatens our fundamental freedoms -- from attacks on reproductive rights to a Trump Administration that's more focused on helping billionaire insiders than lowering costs for families here in New Hampshire.
**We can 't go backward.**
I've beaten their dangerous agenda before. When I first ran for Congress in 2018, people said a Democrat couldn't hold a district like ours for more than a single term. We proved them wrong by staying grounded in our values.
Every day on the campaign trail, I feel that same momentum.
I see it in the seniors who pull me aside to talk about prescription drug costs, and I see it in the young people showing up to No Kings Rallies and getting involved in politics for the first time.
We have a long road ahead, and the fights will only get tougher as the national Republicans pour money into the state to try to eclipse our progress. But if there's one thing churning out all that ice cream at my family's restaurant taught me, it's that you show up and work hard every single day.
**We 're just getting started. I'm ready for the work ahead. I'm ready for the big fights. And I'm ready to be a Senator who always has your back.**
Thank you for reading,

clean_body: If you walk into my family's restaurant in Manchester on any given afternoon, you'll hear the same sounds I've heard my entire life: the clinking of coffee mugs, the hum of blenders, and the rhythm of neighbors talking in a booth. | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more | | | Oct 10 | | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- If you walk into my family's restaurant in Manchester on any given afternoon, you'll hear the same sounds I've heard my entire life: the clinking of coffee mugs, the hum of blenders, and the rhythm of neighbors talking in a booth. It 's the sound of New Hampshire -- and the community that shaped me. My great-grandfather started his business 109 years ago. He was a Greek immigrant who didn't have much, but he believed that if you worked hard, treated people right, and gave back to your community, this country would give you a fair shot. Long before I served in Congress, I was in the kitchen at the restaurant making homemade ice cream. In a year we'd churn out more than 35,000 gallons of it! | | ---|---|--- Helping run my family's small business showed me the power of hard work and serving others. But unfortunately the opportunity that my ancestors and others sought has never been further away, and Donald Trump and his administration are too busy cutting deals for their billionaire buddies to give a damn. I decided to run for Senate to change that. | | ---|---|--- I've traveled across the Granite State on the campaign trail -- from the Seacoast to the North Country -- and the stories I hear are the same: People are working harder than ever and doing everything right but still seem to be falling behind. The system isn't working. More often than not, it feels rigged for those at the top -- while the rest of us are just trying to scrape by. That 's why I'm running for Senate: We deserve leaders who fight for all of us, not just the wealthy and well-connected. And it's about time that our economy works for everyone. I 'm also running to bring a new voice to the Senate and stand up for all Granite Staters. Growing up in New Hampshire, I often wondered if there would be a place for me here -- if I'd be able to live openly and authentically in the state I love. I certainly never imagined I could one day be elected to public office as a member of the LGBTQ+ community. | | ---|---|--- After college I returned home to help run my family's restaurant and decided to run for the state legislature because I wanted to give back to the city and state that had given me so many opportunities. And somewhat to my surprise, not only did my community accept me, they gave me their trust and sent me to Concord to serve them. I'll never forget the first speech I made from the State House floor. At the time marriage equality was far from the law of the land, and the legislature was debating a bill that would have prohibited New Hampshire from recognizing same-sex marriages performed in other states. I told my colleagues that the bill ran counter to the "Live Free or Die" spirit we're so proud of in New Hampshire and that we shouldn't be legislating based on fear or hate or trying to punish people for who they love. Unfortunately the bill passed, and we lost that fight. But we didn 't give up. We persevered, and not long after the legislature passed a new bill recognizing civil unions between same-sex partners. And a few years after that, New Hampshire became the first state in the nation to legalize marriage equality through legislative action. It was a remarkable turnaround that showed real progress is possible, and that's made an immeasurable difference in the lives of so many who call New Hampshire home -- including my husband and me. | | ---|---|--- I 'm not running to make history -- I'm running to make a difference for every Granite Stater who feels like their voice isn't being heard by those who represent them. During this campaign the contrast between me and my opponent, John Sununu, has only grown stronger. I've spent my time in Congress taking on tough fights. I'm ranked one of the most bipartisan members of the House because I'll always look for a chance to deliver results. But I'll also take on anyone to do what's best for New Hampshire -- regardless of political party. We 're seeing a different approach from Sununu and the Republican side. The GOP sows extreme rhetoric and threatens our fundamental freedoms -- from attacks on reproductive rights to a Trump Administration that's more focused on helping billionaire insiders than lowering costs for families here in New Hampshire. We can 't go backward. I've beaten their dangerous agenda before. When I first ran for Congress in 2018, people said a Democrat couldn't hold a district like ours for more than a single term. We proved them wrong by staying grounded in our values. Every day on the campaign trail, I feel that same momentum. I see it in the seniors who pull me aside to talk about prescription drug costs, and I see it in the young people showing up to No Kings Rallies and getting involved in politics for the first time. We have a long road ahead, and the fights will only get tougher as the national Republicans pour money into the state to try to eclipse our progress. But if there's one thing churning out all that ice cream at my family's restaurant taught me, it's that you show up and work hard every single day. We 're just getting started. I'm ready for the work ahead. I'm ready for the big fights. And I'm ready to be a Senator who always has your back. Thank you for reading, Chris Before you go! body:
What this says about this moment in America | | | |
---
| | | Peter,
---
Faith is essential to the survival and success of America.

Charlie Kirk staked his life's work on that truth.

He went straight into the hardest places in our culture and said what too many others were afraid to say, even when the crowd was hostile and the odds were against him.

He understood that if America is going to be renewed, the next generation has to find its way back to faith, truth, and love of country.

That's one reason JD Vance's story meant so much to him: Charlie saw in the Vice President something rare in public life -- a man whose faith had been tested, shaken, and ultimately rebuilt.

**That journey is what JD Vance writes about in his new book,_Communion: Finding My Way Back to Faith._**

Peter, this book isn't just about JD Vance's story...

It speaks to something much bigger happening in our country right now.

So many Americans know what it feels like to live in a culture that is constantly pulling them away from what matters most -- away from faith, from family, and from the values that once held this country together.

Young people face that pressure every single day.

They're told faith is outdated. They're told truth is whatever feels right, or whatever the culture says it is.

JD Vance knows what it is like to live in that confusion.

He knows what it is like to search, to be shaped by a broken culture, and by God's grace, to find his way back.

That's what _Communion_ is about...

And it gets to the heart of what so many families are watching happen in the lives of their children and grandchildren right now.

That's why Turning Point USA is reaching young people where this battle is actually being fought -- on campuses, in classrooms, and in a culture that keeps pressuring them to walk away from faith.

## Neighbors Cry Foul over $1.7B Solar Farm
Robertson County neighbors say they were blindsided by a [$1.7 billion solar project](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L0SmzAQBOCnEZ08ujNgKFSkoXPalIx-DnyJkDySDObtM-QVUu_sNzv76zk_DQeO60-zka7fJc2RjhKoVspzJp95p5x5NyGfLpWNnTWFZlTYS1AS1Gxc5Z3m1jReW-VHaEjDY4T-rgCheWns25agHYbWWoeDwdE627thUR3CvbcN64sDBQpAQTfcOm9JORgWdGQ7UqJV5LmmfKsvqvQ1ZQln2infXNqaoF-1vou4_xA4CZyO47j9sfV7hQKnyxY4gRI4qVHgZANHX9iTl_aUlldZUjBZwsNKipTXU75z-k2uyk_0lKVLsdT8cZVTlOlTr64068oUTPQCpyZr_z44BC79Q7Rq3QyHf9vq_366a_wbAAD__w1BjTY) going up near Bremond. The nearly 10,000-acre project will place 2 million panels beside the Twin Oaks power station, where the [coal plant keeps running](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGSnDAQRL9GZENphGC5QIETsnPqkBpJAztlga4kmb39e9euP8FZd_K66_36XD9Jkpz7TzrYte8tryc_auLWuKyFY5GLS5GLUnmGXA8JniqvRpsJUAPqlUKTi1dLXXRexw_s2OHtA6dBo8Hu7rzxGLy1lu028zAPYxzHccAwUJws-U7cC4caNaLGce7H6FkHnDcT2I-sldUcpeXStzs3_qa6pWe-uPQhH11y99a-qhp-KLMos3Di0Ar_7kNWZnmhlVn07ZWtMgsBgoH9ATUnKrBROUAqFKly7kANCN4TEDIlqNIY_J_2r0mF2ugp567M0hUXvx6SktTppqzeD5L0ftT-1-TlzN8AAAD___k-iA8). One couple says potential buyers have backed out on their home, and another neighbor's front door will sit about 150 feet from the panels. The county's 10-year, 100% tax break includes no protections for those neighbors. It brings in $13 million to $19 million, short of the $25 million to $30 million officials estimate regular taxes would bring, and requires just four full-time jobs. The developer is also [eyeing a possible data center](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0D2SozAQQOHTQCZKLfNjBwo2IfOmG1ItqQHtCkS1esG-_dT4CnOB71W9P8_piTHFffmNG1l5zXna6SqJRIgnpsDxJOZ4YuK3z2WL3mGhyWjTK9AK9IRe4klTi3WwTocH1GRheEB_02CgXq33IVDrPN5neHSgBzM4cLe2H7Dt2-DqaL850KABNHT3pguOtIf7bDy5jnTVagpRMjeyktALy5ze-SRufN7qZFeRo1S3X5UZKzNe19UcpxLya5N5qcx44I5b3EV5PKJgUo4J_xW1cP6_B5V3BcosV_Dqg6uSE7I6OP8lL5UZa7bhuGJKsfRD1eplw5g-bfnps9OarwAAAP__IuKEJA) on site.
## Red Jackets Dance into a Second Century
Hundreds of former Austin High Red Jackets [danced before kickoff](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGuozAQRb_GdEYzdgJJ4WIbumy7JRrsAbwxENmzEP5-lfc-4ZVXV7q65_x59A-KKa7Tb1rYyXvc-pWPkliEc5855LhzznGnlE-_lSX6gQr3BkyjETRCT17izv2FquAGCHes2GF7x8YCGqxm196ste3dsvWBOfAwIrRta5pxtGZEqqL7zCEgIAJeb_U1DAweb6PxPFwZ1AU4RNlyLTMLv6mM6dx2zrXfliq5WeRVlP2lTKdMdxxH_XzT-imV6T48ynRp85SU6ehfkbgq08nM-jvoOU6zzhz0X_JPlqI9Jx4yCWsE0CdT1okn8qcyXZVdeB0xpViaVl1gWiimryPyU4G7M_8DAAD__ywOh5M) at a recent home game to celebrate the group's 100th year. The Red Jackets formed as a girls' service club [in the late 1920s](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGOqzAQgOHTmC5oZrBJKFw86Yku226JjD2BkUyI7BFJbr_aXGH7X1_xf1-na5As9-UrbOz1ddunOz9rZlUuU-FU5OBS5Ai5vONeN4lzqDwRUH9COCFMIaocPNnQJD9DGrBhj-cB-w6QsFm9Y0uWcOiQiBw5lwa8xIgEyUXshkb8L4eAgAjoLq1LM0PEy40iz47BWOAkupdWV1Z-hXrL7_3g0sZ9a7JfVR_VdP8MjYbGoDnUVtfYftJ22Q9D43_WILkaGp11HUBvsW-KT4-n5Cy1PxsLyxYkf0z964vD008AAAD__0TLcgE), soon after Austin High moved to its Rio Grande Street campus. The club was modeled on the University of Texas' Orange Jackets, one alum recalled. The school moved to [its lakeside campus](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLvO4jAQRp_G6YhmJlcKF9u4Ywu22DLyZUIsORjZowBv_wte4e8_fefo_L8sFxtTvN_-2p21vNa83PlZE4twWQqHEg8uJR42lbfPdY_e2coLAY0nhBPCYr3Eg5feNkE7CGdsWON0xrEDJGw2TTg78GPnh951dnJTmCe_TqtlREZam6g_dwgIiIDD3A7BMXicV_LsBgbVA4coubSysfDL1jW988Gl9Xlvkt5EHlV1fxQZRcbbR5Sc2u-wveVDkZGUQ_ZVkZnhqsi4mJLwSxSZTfakyPy7fnR7026yN0WHxzOmFOs4qR5uu43py5LfNjo0_QQAAP__Ajp8Kg) in 1975. Over the decades, the Red Jackets went from marching with the band to competing as an elite dance team that performs year-round. The milestone also brought a ribbon-cutting for a dance studio named for Stephanie Braden Wright, the team's director for the past 25 years.
## Texas Eyes Red River Three-Peat
Unbeaten No. 1 Texas puts its perfect record on the line [against Oklahoma today in Dallas](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDFuwzAMRU9jbwpIObaTQUOXbOna0aAlOiZKR4YkOMntCwcoeoDOj3j8_39dhyuJyv32SQu78pzicOdHVi6F05A4JNk4JdlI08vHvIgfKfNgwXYGwSAM5ItsPBypDm6EcMaaHfZn7BpAi_Xsuob6YMe-6ULPdIa-CT4w-ia0J5o81-J2HQICImB7OrRhZPB4mqznsWWojsBBSkyHMnPhJ-VJX3HjdPBxqdXNpay5aj4qe6nsxUdVvvEUYxlJde-z3_0R84sqe3nbzJZN_Faa40JmTRzEF4l3s8eqkwvrQ1Qld311hNtCou-_5b97bc7-BAAA___KzoOX), where the Longhorns march into the Cotton Bowl as 7.5-point favorites for the 2:30 p.m. kickoff on ABC. Everyone in Sacramento knows exactly what the "Stop Nick Shirley Act" means. On August 22nd, Governor Newsom signed AB 2624. Three days later, I was standing at the State Capitol with a crowd of people who showed up because they understood what this law actually does. Supporters say it protects immigration workers from harassment. Here's what it really does, Peter: it makes it harder for anyone -- me included -- to investigate where your tax dollars are being sent. I said it plainly at the rally: this is not the end; this is just the beginning. Because here's the part that should bother you more than anything else. The assemblymember who wrote this bill is married to California's Attorney General -- the one person in this state whose entire job is supposed to be going after fraud. Instead, his wife wrote the bill that makes it harder to expose it. That's not a coincidence, Peter. That's the system protecting itself. I've spent the last year showing up where legacy media won't -- daycare centers, tax-funded nonprofits, the offices of people who'd rather I disappear than answer a question. That work is exactly why a state legislature decided to write a law with my name on it instead of going after the fraud I keep finding. A state senator at the rally called it unconstitutional. A city attorney called it a direct threat to the First Amendment. They're right -- and they're not going to be the ones who stop it. That's going to take people willing to fund the reporters still asking the questions. Here's something most people don't see, Peter: doing this work independently means there's no network paying for the flight to Sacramento, no legal department covering me if a state files a complaint over a story, no corporate budget for the cameras and editors it takes to get this footage in front of you. name: Eugene Vindman
subject: My decision
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Alex Vindman for Florida
body:
Here's the truth
Peter –
As I was having my coffee yesterday morning, I was thinking about my journey to this moment. I never imagined that I would be here today, representing the people of Virginia’s 7th district, and fighting for our future in Congress.
I’m a Jewish-Ukrainian immigrant whose family came to America to find hope like so many others, and I was proud to join the military and serve my country.
When my brother, Lt. Col. Alexander Vindman, heard President Trump’s infamous call with Ukraine, we knew our oath to defend our country and the Constitution required us to report the call up the chain of command.
Because we did not let Trump's abuse of his office stand, he was impeached — and his vengeance cost us our careers when we were fired in retaliation.
Back then, I never thought I would run for Congress. But in the years following, we saw Republicans go all-in on authoritarianism. And to this day, with Donald Trump in office, that threat exists. More than ever.
It started with the attempted coup of January 6th, Trump and his allies illegally meddling in fair elections, and the GOP rolling back our fundamental rights.
Now, it's the attacks against working people. The corruption. The stripping of healthcare away from millions of families. And another endless war in the Middle East risking the lives of our service members and raising costs here at home.
Throughout it all, I've stood my ground. I’ve fought for working families and been a voice for our service members. And I’ve even dared to hold Trump accountable again on the House floor, knowing I would face his vengeance once again. And to no one’s surprise, I did. He launched a sham investigation into me to kick me out of Congress.
But not for a second did I doubt my decisions, Peter. Why? Because we can’t sit by while our country is brought to its breaking point like this.
So when I heard the call to serve two years ago, I did what I always did. I answered it.
But the reality is that threat remains — and its not going anywhere as long as Trump’s minions in Congress continue to grant him unchecked power.
So now I am trying to continue my service in Congress. For you. For our democracy. And for the future of our republic.
But I cannot do this alone. I need your help to get across the finish line. The path to the House majority and putting a check on Trump’s power runs through VA-07, and we cannot fall behind on our fundraising if we want to have the resources we need to win this race.

## Toplines for the Week
Democrats won the past week not because of major structural indicator movement, not because of headlines, not even because of polls.
They won because the line of scrimmage moved.
Republicans now aren't just fighting in the red zone--they're playing goal line defense. Yet even as the fight has moved to places where there should be a distinct Republican home field advantage, Democrats are more than holding their own.
I could see it myself as I put in the numbers in my weekly tracking database: I realized that I now have to pay real attention to a bunch of new races. And the kicker was what the anti-Trump Republican who co-hosts my weekly politics show told me what he was hearing out of _Kansas_ (see below). Holy smokes.

body:
This is the last and biggest test of our grassroots strength before Election Day.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1879&source=&t=1&akid=4401%2E124072%2ELKiIo-) | | | |

Peter, I’m sorry to be so blunt, but I have to ask:
[**_Will you chip in $5 to my Senate campaign here in North Carolina today?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1879&amount=5&t=8&akid=4401%2E124072%2ELKiIo-)
Let me explain why your support is so important – and what could happen without it.
1. The last FEC fundraising deadline of this election is on Wednesday. When it closes, we’re legally required to report how much we’ve raised and how many donations we’ve received.
2. This report will be public, so everyone will be watching to gauge the strength of our grassroots movement in this final stretch.
3. We’ve set an ambitious $3 million goal, and we can’t meet it without your help. Early in-person voting in North Carolina starts the day _right after_ this FEC fundraising deadline. If we don’t have the resources to reach and turn out the voters we need to win, we could put our chances of flipping this seat at serious risk.
**Thousands of grassroots supporters are chipping in today to fuel this movement. Now, I’m asking you to join them. Please, Peter:**
[**_Will you give $5 or whatever you can today to help us reach our crucial $3 million goal before the FEC deadline, win in North Carolina and take back the Senate?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1879&amount=5&t=9&akid=4401%2E124072%2ELKiIo-)

Hillsdale College's popular online course, **" The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives,"** is now FREE on DVD.

In this six-lecture course, you'll explore some of the major themes of Genesis, including the complex relationship between God and man, and what it reveals about divine and human nature.

"The Genesis Story" is taught by Hillsdale College professor of English Justin Jackson, who has taught the subject to undergraduate students here at the College for 15 years. This course aims to deepen a student's theological understanding of the Old Testament by revealing the literary beauty and complexity of the text.

The course begins with a lecture and introduction by the president of Hillsdale College, Larry P. Arnn, in which he explains why we teach the Book of Genesis at Hillsdale College and why it's important to both faith and higher education.

Then, Dr. Jackson explains the four relationships that dominate the Book of Genesis: God and creation, God and man, man and man, and man and creation.
